component.name: Salt-Default
component.summary: Choose default applications for file and link types

description.p: Salt-Default is a Windows-style Default Apps settings panel for Linux. It lets you pick which application opens a given kind of file or link, from a single graphical interface.

ul.li: Set defaults per application, per file type (MIME), or per link type
Uses the standard XDG mimeapps.list, so other desktop apps respect your choice
Shows whether a default comes from your user config or the system
Reloads automatically when mimeapps.list changes elsewhere
